name: text
title: Text
summary: Every piece of copy, set in one of the system's type styles.
use: Use it for any text that is not part of another component.

options.name: variant
options.description: reading for body copy, heading for item titles, title for the page name, small for supporting text, label for mono uppercase labels, mono for code and footers.

options.name: tone
options.description: accent only at title size, for one phrase of two or three words.

rules: Three weights: 300 reading, 400 headings and controls, 500 title.
Sentence case everywhere; labels are uppercased by the style, not by the copy.
accessibility: Sizes scale with the reader's text size (rem on the web, Dynamic Type in Swift).
